alchemistaccelerator-siro:ashbyhq:fc8a2b.description: Field sales powers the economy — but most teams are struggling. Reps are buried in admin work, managers are stretched thin, and leaders can’t see what’s really happening in the field. Siro is redefining how field sales teams learn, perform, and win. We started as an AI-powered coaching platform that helped reps improve their outcomes in the field. Today, we’re something much bigger — an intelligent companion that automates sales reps’ tedious admin work, gives managers real-time visibility, and helps executives see around corners. Our platform integrates with systems like Salesforce, analyzing thousands of in-person sales conversations to surface insights, automate workflows, and drive better outcomes across the org. Think Iron Man’s Jarvis for sales — proactive, personalized, and built directly into the tools teams already use. Siro has raised $75M and is backed by world-class investors like Index, Fika, CRV, and SignalFire. We are trusted by leading home-improvement, retail, hospitality, and automotive brands, and powered by a lean team from Meta, McKinsey, Doordash, and Uber. We’re building the future of human-AI collaboration in sales — and we’re just getting started. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - Contribute to the development, improvement, and long-term architecture of our React Native mobile application across iOS and Android. - Own core feature delivery end-to-end in React Native, from technical design to implementation and release. - Collaborate closely with product, design, and backend teams to translate requirements into reliable, scalable app experiences. - Maintain, refine, and modernize our existing React Native codebase, with an eye toward performance, stability, and long-term maintainability. - Uphold code quality through reviews, testing, documentation, and collaboration with fellow engineers. - Ensure application performance, reliability, and security standards are consistently met. - Contribute to continuous improvement of our engineering practices and mobile development processes. - Stay updated with emerging best practices in mobile and React Native development, and introduce improvements where beneficial. REQUIREMENTS - You have deep expertise in React Native (6+ years of experience, with multiple meaningful production deployments). - You have hands-on experience maintaining and scaling existing React Native applications, not just greenfield builds. - You are comfortable working in Swift and/or Kotlin when needed to extend or augment React Native functionality (supplementary/native skill, not primary focus). - You have demonstrated experience leading technical initiatives, owning projects, and working with high performing engineering teams. - You are well-versed in mobile engineering best practices, including performance optimization, security, testing, and release management. - You have experience creating and implementing Git-based workflows and CI/CD pipelines for mobile app releases. - You demonstrate strong problem-solving and communication skills, and can clearly articulate tradeoffs and technical decisions. WHY JOIN SIRO? - Growth: Join a rapidly scaling Series B startup with proven product-market fit - Technology: Work with cutting-edge AI technologies and a modern tech stack - Team: Collaborate with an experienced CEO (previously built a successful sales tool used by 100,000+ reps) and top-tier team - Ownership: Take end-to-end ownership of features that directly impact our users - Learning: Work across the full stack and grow your technical breadth - Impact: Help democratize sales success and create opportunities for millions of sales professionals At Siro, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment where all people feel that they are equally respected and valued, whether they are applying for an open position or working at the company. getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:1b3ddc1c-eb3.title: Field & Events Marketer
getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:1b3ddc1c-eb3.description: Wing is seeking elite talent to join M32 AI (backed by top-tier Silicon Valley VCs), dedicated to building agentic AI for traditional service businesses. Think of it like a startup within a corporate: fast moving and agile, with the stability of a corporate, and zero bureaucracy. If you’re driven by challenge and eager to make a significant impact in a high-caliber role, this is the opportunity you’ve been waiting for. We're hiring a Field & Events Marketer to own our presence at industry events, tradeshows, and conferences across North America. You'll source the right shows, run them end to end, and be the person on the ground making sure every event drives real pipeline. This is a hands-on role for someone 1-4 years into their career who loves logistics, thrives in fast-paced environments, and gets a kick out of pulling off a great event. You'll partner closely with sales, marketing, and product to turn booth space and badge scans into meetings, opportunities, and closed revenue. Why This Role You'll own a high-visibility function from day one. Every event is a chance to shape how customers, prospects, and the industry see us. If you want to grow fast, take real ownership, and build a portfolio of events you're genuinely proud of, this is the seat for you.
responsibilities: Source and prioritize events. Research, evaluate, and recommend tradeshows, conferences, and industry events that align with our ICP and revenue goals. Own a rolling 12-month event calendar.
Negotiate and contract. Manage relationships with event organizers, vendors, and venues. Negotiate sponsorships, booth space, speaking slots, and add-ons to stretch every dollar.
Plan and execute end to end. Own every detail, including booth design and shipping, swag, collateral, lead capture, badge scanners, AV, catering, hotel blocks, and travel logistics for the team.
Be the on-site point of contact. Attend every event in person. Set up and tear down booths, troubleshoot in real time, and make sure our presence looks sharp from start to finish.
Prep the team. Brief attending team members on objectives, talking points, target accounts, and logistics. Make sure everyone knows where to be, when, and what to do.
Drive pipeline with sales. Partner with sales to book pre-show meetings, run dinners and customer events on-site, and ensure every lead is captured, qualified, and followed up on quickly.
Run pre- and post-event campaigns. Work with marketing on email outreach, landing pages, paid promotion, and social to drive booth traffic and meeting bookings before the show.
Own the budget. Manage event spend across the full calendar. Track costs, forecast accurately, flag risks early, and make smart trade-off decisions when priorities shift.
Define KPIs and report on results. Set clear KPIs for each event (leads, meetings, pipeline, ROI) and build clean post-event reports that show what worked, what didn't, and how to improve next time.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:bcdf4f6a-879a-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a System/Site Designer based in United States. This is an opportunity for a skilled designer to lead projects from early concepts through detailed design development and final site layouts. You will create accurate, professional 2D and 3D drawings that support customers, certification agencies, permitting authorities, sales teams, and internal operations. The role combines technical design expertise with practical problem-solving, requiring close collaboration across engineering, sales, and design functions. You will work extensively with Revit, AutoCAD, BIM, and cloud-based technologies while helping establish and improve design standards. Your work will directly contribute to manufacturable, compliant, and visually compelling project solutions. The position offers a collaborative environment with opportunities to improve workflows, develop technical expertise, and influence documentation practices. This is a remote, full-time role with professional development, training, flexibility, and opportunities for career advancement. Lead the design and development of projects from initial concepts through detailed design and site layout. Use Revit to create and maintain designs for customers, certification agencies, local jurisdictions, and internal operations teams. Produce accurate 2D and 3D project drawings and renderings using Revit, BIM, AutoCAD, Civil 3D, and cloud-based technologies. Consult with clients to understand project requirements and translate their needs into effective design solutions. Support sales activities by preparing professional drawing packages for bids and proposals. Partner with engineering teams to prepare submittal packages required for certifications and permitting. Identify and resolve complex design challenges using practical, innovative, and manufacturable solutions. Conduct thorough self-checks to ensure drawings are complete, accurate, compliant with applicable standards, and suitable for manufacturing and implementation. Serve as a key resource for Revit setup and standards, including templates, families, shared parameters, and annotation standards. Help evaluate and implement workflow improvements that strengthen documentation standards and efficiency. Collaborate with design leads on content and library management. Ensure designs and work practices comply with applicable OSHA, EPA, local regulatory requirements, and safety policies. Requirements: 3–5 years of relevant design or drafting experience, including exposure to Revit standards, templates, or organization-wide content management. Experience with Autodesk design products, particularly Revit, AutoCAD, or Civil 3D . Familiarity with electrical, plumbing, and mechanical design principles. Ability to interpret technical specifications and recommend appropriate design improvements. Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing accurate, complete, compliant, and manufacturable designs. Ability to work effectively with clients and cross-functional teams, including sales, engineering, and design professionals. An associate degree from an accredited CAD training program is preferred but not required. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to develop practical solutions to complex design issues. Familiarity with relevant safety standards and the ability to work in accordance with applicable regulations and organizational policies. qualdoc-qualdoc:lever:70aaf269-1f12-4390.description: CNC Sheet Metal Punch Press Operator Location: Baltimore, MD Job Type: Contract-to-Hire Starting Pay: From $20.00/hour (Higher pay available based on experience) Position Overview We are seeking a skilled CNC Sheet Metal Punch Press Operator to produce precision sheet metal components in a manufacturing environment. This role requires experience setting up and operating CNC turret punch presses, reading blueprints, verifying part quality, and maintaining efficient production with minimal material waste.
responsibilities: Set up and operate CNC turret punch presses for sheet metal production.
Install and change punch tooling and verify programs before production.
Load and unload sheet material safely.
Confirm material type, thickness, grain direction, finish, and drawing revision before starting work.
Select appropriate tooling and understand punching clearances and sheet layout optimization .
Perform first-piece inspections before production runs.
Monitor machine operation and make adjustments to maintain part quality.
Remove completed parts while minimizing damage and scrap.
Deburr parts or route them to required secondary operations.
Read and interpret engineering drawings, work orders, and manufacturing instructions .
Identify hole locations, forming requirements, hardware locations, embosses, louvers, extrusions, countersinks, and bend reliefs.
Verify dimensions and tolerances throughout production.
Properly identify and separate work in process by job and operation.
Maintain production paperwork and follow established safety procedures.
qualifications: 3+ years of CNC turret punch press experience.
3+ years of machine setup experience.
Ability to independently perform complete machine setups.
Strong blueprint and engineering drawing reading skills.
Experience changing and maintaining punch tooling.
Experience with aluminum, stainless steel, and carbon steel .
Understanding of tooling selection, punching clearances, and material layout.
Experience using precision measuring equipment .
Strong mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting ability.
Detail-oriented with strong communication and organizational skills.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
Forklift experience preferred.
Ability to stand for extended periods.
Ability to lift up to 50 lbs.
Frequent bending, reaching, and lifting.
Ability to safely handle sheet metal and finished components.

roadrunnerstudios-roadrunner-studios:lev.title: Experimental Fluid Mechanics: Two-Phase Flow & Nozzle Testing (Contract)
roadrunnerstudios-roadrunner-studios:lev.description: Overview Roadrunner Venture Studios is seeking a contract Subject Matter Expert (SME) to develop and execute an experimental test program for a proprietary nozzle for the generation of two-phase flow targeting intermediate-temperature energy systems. The primary objective is to establish a reliable, repeatable methodology for thrust measurement, characterize the two-phase flow exiting the nozzle, and reduce system variables so testing is focused on nozzle performance. Scope of Work The contractor will: Develop and execute a test plan for a two-phase nozzle operating with geothermal working fluids and experimental refrigerants. Design and validate a reliable thrust measurement system. Characterize the spray leaving the nozzle, including gas-to-liquid ratio, droplet concentration, droplet distribution, and mixed-phase flow behavior. Measure and analyze flow characteristics, pressure, temperature, and other critical performance parameters. Reduce experimental variables to isolate nozzle performance and improve test repeatability. Recommend and implement instrumentation and test fixtures required to produce high-confidence data. Analyze results and provide recommendations to improve nozzle performance and overall test methodology. Preferred Qualifications M.S. or Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering or related field preferred. Hands-on experience with two-phase flow, organic rankine cycle systems, refrigerant testing, or nozzle/thrust measurement. Strong experimental background with fluid systems, instrumentation, and test development. Experience with compressor and refrigerant line design, HVAC or process engineering, or propulsion testing is highly desirable. Ability to travel to Albuquerque, New Mexico, to support testing.
